title: The Twin Dune Canon
summary: A canon of two great dunes of sand raised in step and rolled together so that the meeting crushes the foe.

title: Treatise of the Azure Sandfall
summary: A treatise on sand poured from the open sky in one heavy fall that buries the ground below it.

title: The Basin Sandglass Mastery
summary: A mastery of pouring blows and qi through the body like sand through a glass and loosing it below.

title: The Hawk Dust-Wing Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of wings of dust that lift the user above the foe and drop on the chosen mark.

title: Canon of the River Sand
summary: A canon of sand run like a river over the ground to carry away footing and bind whatever it passes.

title: The Plateau Sand Canon
summary: A canon of broad dry sand laid flat across open ground that wears all it covers to nothing.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Sworn Dust
summary: A treatise on dust sworn to a single oath so that it seals and scours whoever breaks that oath.

title: The Windward Grain Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of grains driven before the wind that let the user dissolve to dust and pass through narrow gaps.

title: Manual of the Held Bearing in Sand
summary: A manual of a bearing held steady through moving sand so each strike lands true on a shifting field.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Dustfall
summary: A canon of a dustfall that stops nowhere and wears at every edge in its path.
